title: justicia protracta
intro: Justicia protracta, commonly known as the Mexican honeysuckle, is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and swelling, and protect against cell damage. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to act as an antimicrobial and antifungal agent, making it effective in treating infections and wounds. Justicia protracta contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
